rows.jyutping: jung6 waai4 ji4 ge3 ngaan5 gwong1
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for looking at or treating someone in a way that shows suspicion.

example.english: They looked at me suspiciously, and I didn't know why.
example.traditional: 佢用懷疑嘅眼光睇住我，搞到我都唔知點解。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 waai4 ji4 ge3 ngaan5 gwong1 tai2 zyu6 ngo5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2

rows.jyutping: ci5 dou3 ling6 jan4 waai4 ji4 hai6 N V
rows.note: Use this when something resembles N or V so strongly that the resemblance itself makes people suspect it.

example.traditional: 呢份文件似到令人懷疑係偽造嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 man4 gin6 ci5 dou3 ling6 jan4 waai4 ji4 hai6 ngai6 zou6 ge3

rows.note: Use this sentence-level construction when the circumstances or action cause people to become suspicious.

example.english: They only got home at three in the morning, which was suspiciously late.
example.traditional: 佢凌晨三點先返到屋企，令人起疑。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ling4 san4 saam1 dim2 sin1 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 ling6 jan4 hei2 ji4
